(ja)༄༅/ /kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum gyi dkar chag bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /na mo bud+dhā ya/rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud la/gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum gyi dkar chag bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo bud+dhā ya/ rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud la/ gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyu/ rgyu phyi ma le'u bco brgyad pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje phreng ba/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'o// gshin rje gshed dgra nag po/ gzhon nu gdong drug rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'o// shes rab kyi rgyud la/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rtsa ba'i rgyud rtog pa bcu pa/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ zla gsang thig le/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ de'i bshad rgyud man+t+ra aṃ sa/ ma hā mā yā/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi/ 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud la a bhi dha na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ kun tu spyod pa/ khrag 'thung mngon 'byung*/ phag mo mngon 'byung*/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor gyi rgyud/ 'bum phrag gsum las ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i nang nas le'u gcig bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba'o// //gnyis su med pa'i rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kye'i rdo rje/ rgyud phyi ma phyag rgya chen po'i thig le bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur/ ye shes thig le/ de kho na sgron ma/ gsang ba'i sgron ma/ de kho na nyid man ngag rnyog pa med pa/ rdo rje a ral+li/ ṛ gi a ral+li/ dpal mgon po mngon par 'byung ba/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho mchog tu gsal ba las thod pa brtag pa'i le'u gsum pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ dam pa dang po rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud bsdus pa/ dbang gi don rgyud kyi dum bu/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa/ gong ma thams cad kyi bshad pa'i rgyud saṃ pu ṭa brtag pa bcu pa rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'o// dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud phra mo 'ga' dang*/ ra li nyer bzhi snang ste dri ma med pa de kho na yin nam gzhan yin nam ma yin the tshom za'o//

//gsang sngags rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la/ de nyid bsdus pa/ rdo rje rtse mo/ dpal mchog dang po/ khams gsum rnam rgyal/ mgon po kun snang*/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ thams cad gsang ba'o// //gsang sngags spyod pa'i rgyud la/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud/ pra khog snang zhes bya ba rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ rgyud phyi ma dang*/ rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma gsum bzhugs so// //bya ba'i rgyud dang de'i nang tshan la rtog pa'i rgyud ces kyang brjod mod kyi/ dbye ba dka' bas phyogs gcig tu brjod na de yang mtha' yas mod kyi/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud le'u brgyad ma/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud le'u dgu ma/ yang dag pa yin min dpyad/ mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa chen po/ rigs gsum so so'i rgyud/ rig pa lha mo'i rgyud do// //dang po la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dbang du byas na dpa' bo drug pa tshang bar bzhugs/ rgyud rgyas pa kun nas phyung nas dum bu kun la/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ 'jam dpal gyis dmod btsugs pa/ shes rab blo 'phel/ shes rab bskyed pa/ 'jam dpal gho ṣa ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi yig 'bru gcig pa'o// //spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang du byas na don yon zhags pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ a mo gha bā sha'i rtog pa chen po/ phyag stong spyan stong gi rtog pa rgyas pa/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa za ma tog bkod pa'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ spyan ras gzigs ha la ha la'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ 'phags pa me kha la'i snying rje mi bshol ba'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi yum/ spyan ras gzigs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yid bzhin nor bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ ha ya gṛ ba'i gzungs dum bu/ seng ge sgras dam bcas pa'i gzungs dum bu/

pad+ma cod pan yang dag pa yin min dpyad// //phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud la/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ 'phags pa rig pa mchog dpung pa bzang po/ rdo rje sa 'og gcig 'phags pa rdo rje sa 'og dang*/ 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba la sogs pa mang du snang ste bod ma yin no// rdo rje rnam 'joms/ de'i bshad rgyud ri rab chen po'i khang bu brtsegs pa dang*/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar 'bar ba rmongs byed/ rdo rje snying po'i gzungs/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa stobs po che'i gzungs/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po'i gzungs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs dum bu/ 'phags pa rdo rje'i mchu/ gnam lcags mchu'i dum bu/ 'phags pa lcags kyi mchu/ 'phags pa lcags kyi mchu nag po/ klu'i rgyal po bya khyung bya ba de bod ma yin/ drang srong klu la dmod pa bor ba'i gzungs/ sog ma med pa'i rtog pa rgyas pa'o// //rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyi gzungs la/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar rgyas 'bring lnga yod pa las gsum bod du 'gyur/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa/ 'od zer can gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud/ de'i rtog pa chen po/ 'phags pa rdo rje lcags sgrog 'phags pa skul byed ma'i gzungs/ gza' rnams kyi yum/ gzungs gra lnga/ 'phags pa be con chen mo/ 'phags pa yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ 'phags pa rnam par rgyal ba/ 'phags pa phyir zlog ma rnam par rgyal ba can ma/ gtsug tor nag mo bod ma yin/ thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin ma/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ mi 'jigs ma sbyin ma phyir zlog ma stobs can/ bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ma/ 'phags pa dug sel/ mdangs phyir 'phrog ma/ rin po che phreng ba'i dum bu/ 'phags pa rgyal ba can/ 'phags pa ri khrod lo ma can/ me ltar 'bar ba'i gzungs/

rig sngags rgyal mo sgron ma mchog dbyig dang ldan ma/ yi ge drug pa'i gzungs/ 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo/ dpal chen mo'i mdo/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ mig nad rnam par sbyong ba/ gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo/ mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa/ lha mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum/ gtsug gi nor bu/ tsan+dan gyi yan lag dri ma med pa/ stong 'khyil pa/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum/ thun mong gi mdo la/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ bsam gtan phyi ma/ gser 'od dam pa'i mdo/ 'og min gyi tshe dpag med/ bde ba can gyi tshe dpag med/ chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang*/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba'i gzungs chen mo/ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa/ mtshan mo bzang po/ 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la/ ye shes ta la la/ ye shes skar mda' dang de gnyis dum bur bzhugs/ me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ rig sngags lha mo kun nas 'od/ de'i ming gzhan pa'i dbang po yang zer/ kun tu bzang po/ gser can/ 'dus pa chen po/ mdo chen po kun tu rgyu ba/ ming mthun pa sangs rgyas bdun pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ bu mang po rton pa/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi yan lag dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'o// //sor mo can/ lus kyi dbyibs mdzes/ bde ba bsgrags pa/ mchod pa'i sprin/ stong 'gyur/ ka ka ni/ drug po de gzungs sngags kyi dum bur bzhugs/ chos thams cad yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po/ sgo drug pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po/ bdud rtsi sman gyi gzungs/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa/

sprin chen po las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i le'u drug pa gcig pu/ yang sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u thams cad kyi snying po/ de gnyis ka dbu yod gzhug med/ 'dus pa chen po rin po che'i tog 'dus pa chen po nyi ma'i snying po/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkod pa kun tu ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rgyud rgyas pa nas phyung ba'o// //'jig rten pa'i rgyud la/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs/ gar mkhan mchog gi rtog pa chen po/ mgon po dang lha mo'i gzungs gnyis snang ste yang dag pa mi 'dra/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur la/ gsang ba'i snying po sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu pa/ sgyu 'phrul bla ma/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul/ thabs kyi zhags pa/ de rnams yang dag pa 'dra/ lhag ma legs par rtogs par gyis/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dkar chag che rags lags so// // ༄༅// bla ma gong ma'i chos skor gyi dkar chag bzhugs// ༄༅// mal gyo las 'ongs pa'i/ gshin rje rnams ni 'di yin gsung*// zhal gsum pa dang phyag drug pa// zhal dgu yan lag bcas pa'o// bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ de'i bshad rgyud ni nges brjod bla ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ khrag 'thung mngon byung*/ kun tu spyod pa/ de rnams skor lngar gsungs pa las rtsa rgyud kyi skor nag po chos drug ni/ dkyil 'khor cho ga sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gsang ba'i de nyid/ o la pa ti/ dpyid kyi thig le'o// kun tu spyod pa yan lag dang bcas pa ni/ lū hi pa/ rin chen rdo rje ma/ phyi mchod/ lag mchod/ gtor ma/ tshogs kyi gzhung gnyis/ rdo rje chu sbyin pa bstod pa dang bcas pa/ rgyun bshags/ phrin las bcol ba'i gzhung*/ bkra shis/ rig ma bcu drug rin chen bdun/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod yon/ bstod pa bzhi so sor byas na nyi shu'o//

//bshad rgyud gsum skor cig rdo rje dril bu'i skor la/ dkyil 'khor cho ga rim lnga/ bskyed rim mo// ke ka na'i skor dang lnga'o// //'grel pa gsungs pa ni/ rtsa rgyud la/ sgrub thabs kyi gleng gzhi/ mkha' 'gro ma bha ba ma/ khrag 'thung 'byung ba'i 'grel pa'o// i thi// //kun spyod dang lū hi pa'i 'grel pa re yod de tshogs pa la bshad pa yin pas ma dag de rnams mal gyo lo tsā ba'i bde mchog skor lnga'o// bde mchog sdom 'byung*/ phyag na rdo rje'i bstod 'grel dang*/ phran tshegs gzhan gsungs pa rnams mal gyo'i ma yin no// nā ro'i rjes 'brang bde mchog gzhung*// skor lnga bla ma las bshad pa'i// mal gyo dag las rim 'ongs pa// dbu ma mkha' spyod dag dang ni// phag mo la sogs sgrub pa'i thabs// phran tshegs 'dir ni ma bris so// gzhan gyi phyi rol 'khor yin pas// rnam pa kun tu spang ba'i rigs// rje ba ri snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i chos bsam gyis mi khyab kyang gtso che bar gsungs pa ni/ don yod zhags pa yan lag bcas// rnam rgyal yan lag bcas pa dang*// sgrub thabs bsdus pa dag dang ni// rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug dang*// dang po'i las pa'i bya bar bcas// lha dgu la sogs bsam mi khyab// ba ri rin chen grags pa yis// bod la phan pa'i don du bsgyur// kye rdor bde mchog nag 'jigs dang*// ba ri'i man ngag sna tshogs dang*// gdams ngag phran tshegs sna tshogs kyi// dkar chag rnams ni ma bris te// gzhung gi dkar chag che long tsam// grags pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis bsdebs// des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar 'gro shog/ // ༄༅// kye rdo rje'i chos skor kyi dkar chag bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swā sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// brtag pa gnyis pa/ gur/ saṃ pu ṭa/ brtag pa gnyis la 'grel pa ku mu ti/ dkyil 'khor cho ga bzang po yongs bzung*/

sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ gtum mo'i 'grel chung*/ sbyin sreg phyag mtshan gyi dag pa/ gtor ma/ sngags don/ yang sngags don gcig bdud rtsi 'od/ lhan cig skyes grub/ lam gyi yan lag la/ de nyid bcu pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dran pa gcig pa/ dpa' mo gcig yang dpa' mo gcig ma/ rin chen 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/ man ngag gi ro sreg kyang yin/ de rnams ḍoṃ bi ba'i skor ro// brtag pa gnyis pa 'grel pa pad+mo can/ dkyil chog nas gling ma/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes rdo rje/ tshogs 'khor/ dam tshig lnga pa/ bstod pa/ gur gyi bshad sbyar/ phyag bcu drug pa dkar po/ skabs kyi 'grel pa brgyad de de ni gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa rtsa'i mngon rtogs chen po/ chung ba/ dur khrod kyi 'grel pa chen po/ chung ba/ brda'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje'i glu'i 'grel pa che chung gnyis de rnams pad+ma'i skor ro// ro sreg cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ de rnams lo tsā ba nyid kyis mdzad de de'i slob mas phyag mtshan gyi dag pa byas/ de rnams rje btsun rin po che 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi'o// //brtag pa gnyis la 'grel pa rnal 'byor rin po che sbyor ba'i phreng ba/ dkyil 'khor cho ga gzhung 'grel/ sgrub thabs de nyid gsal ba/ phyag bcu drug pa dpa' bo gcig phyag gnyis pa dpa' bo gcig lam gyi yan lag la/ rab gnas tshul zab mo/ sbyin sreg ro sreg tshogs 'khor/ bstod pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis/ rdzogs rim gyi gzhung*/ de rnams nag chung gis 'gos khug pa las brgyud pa'o// kye'i rdo rje'i chos skor gtso che bar gsungs pa rnams so// //kye'i rdo rje'i chos skor skabs su gsungs pa'i 'grel pa ni/ rdo rje snying po ma/ bha ba ma/ dran pa'i 'byung gnas ma/ mu tig phreng ba/ pad+mo can/ ku mu ti/ dam tshig rdo rje ma'o// gur gyi 'grel pa/ lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i che chung gnyis/

in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa'i saṃ pu ṭa'i 'grel pa chen po/ shān+ti pa'i chos skor rnams las mu tig phreng ba 'khrul spong*/ lhan cig skyes pa/ he ru ka 'byung ba'o// yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ ḍoṃ bi ba'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa sbyin sreg me trī pas mdzad pa'i rnam par dag pa'i gter dang*/ bdag med ma gsal ba rnams so// dbang rab byed/ lta ba ngan sel rtsa 'grel gnyis/ rnam dag gter/ bdag med gsal ba/ rin chen phreng ba/ dbang gi dgongs pa/ dbang rnam par nges pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i phyag rgya rnam par bshad pa/ a ma na si/ theg pa chen po nyi shu pa/ de kho na nyid bcu pa/ rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar bstan pa/ rmi lam bstan pa/ sgyu ma nges bstan/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rjes su bstan pa/ mi phyed lnga pa/ brtse ba lnga pa/ dga' gcugs lnga pa/ bde chen gsal med/ lhan cig skyes pa'i drug pa/ gnas thabs bsdus pa/ dbang nges bstan gyi 'grel pa/ shes rab ye shes gsal ba/ rdo rje'i tshig bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa/ sgrub pa brgyud pa'i rim pa'o// kye'i rdo rje'i chos skor rnams rdzogs so// //snying po'i don gyi kye yi rdo rje ni/ bir+wa'i rjes 'brang ḍoṃ bi'i skor// yan lag med rjes pad+ma'i skor// dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor// gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu// lam skor dgu ni khyad par ro// dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis kye'i rdo rje'i dkar chag bris pa yin no// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
